name: logcn
description: Schema-first wide-event telemetry that lives in your repo — shadcn for observability

scripts.smoke: pnpm --filter @logcn/example-basic smoke && pnpm --filter @logcn/example-express-smoke smoke && pnpm --filter @logcn/example-fastify-smoke smoke && pnpm --filter @logcn/example-standalone smoke && pnpm --filter @logcn/example-next-smoke smoke
scripts.ci: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm size && pnpm registry:build && pnpm format:check:events && pnpm publish:smoke
